interview.name: Leo
interview.answer: The repair drive time and location haven’t been set yet.

reflections: Leo is dependable and takes on practical coordination tasks.
Uli relies on Leo for organizing repair-drive logistics.
Faye is willing to help, but needs scheduling details to fit her availability.
Leo is taking a practical coordination role, handling sorting and asking for next steps when the work is still ambiguous.
Faye is willing to help around scheduling and fitting the repair drive into family logistics.
Gus and Nell are supportive helpers: Gus can provide tools and concrete guidance, while Nell is staying alert for extra supplies and passing information along.
Leo coordinates repair work by delegating sorting and labeling tasks, while others handle logistics and supplies.
Nell is a passive but reliable information source, focused on tracking down tools and spare parts.
Mara is ready to help immediately with hands-on organization and sign-up support, suggesting a cooperative, task-oriented group.
Leo tends to coordinate the repair drive logistics and task flow for others.
Mara is supportive and proactive with hands-on organizing work like sorting and labeling donated parts.
Several people need repeated confirmation of the repair drive details, so the group should keep the time and drop-off location clear and easy to resend.
Leo is coordinating the repair drive and others are responding with concrete offers to help.
Opal and Faye want precise logistics before committing, so clarity on location and time matters.
Ira is taking a proactive relay role by checking needs on-site and passing updates back to Leo.

events.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next task?
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. Could you help sort the donated parts and label what still needs fixing?
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll sort the donated parts and label anything that still needs fixing.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off. What time is the repair drive happening?
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — it’s set for Saturday morning, around 9 to 11. I’ll send the exact address.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Faye: That works for me — I can plan around school pickup then. Send the address when you have it, and I’ll try to help coordinate.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll sort the donated parts and label what still needs fixing. What should I tackle first?
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Gus: Great — start with the smallest, easiest fixes and set those aside for anyone ready to jump in. I’ve got tools on hand if you need anything.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll pull the small easy fixes first and set them aside. If I run into anything tricky, I’ll grab the tools from you.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Nell: I’ve still only heard a few scraps, but I’m keeping an ear out for any extra supplies or tools. If I catch anything useful, I’ll pass it along right away.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Leo: Thanks, Nell. I’m sorting the donated parts now—if you hear about any tools, just send them my way.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll keep listening and pass along anything I hear about tools or spare parts.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Leo: What should I tackle first?
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Quinn: Thanks, Faye — I’ll get you the repair drive time and address as soon as they’re set.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Leo: Sounds good—just send me the time and address when you have them, and I’ll keep sorting the donated parts.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Mara: I’ve got the clipboard and tape, and I can help keep the sign-ups moving. If you need anything sorted or labeled, I’m on it.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Leo: Great—could you start by sorting the donated parts into keep and fix piles? I’ll label the ones that still need attention.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated parts into keep and fix piles now. Just point me to where you want the labeled ones set aside.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Opal: Could you remind me of the repair drive details one more time? I want to make sure I have everything right before I commit.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next task?
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Opal: Could you send me the exact drop-off spot and the time again? I want to make sure I’ve got the repair drive details right before I commit.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Mara: I can sort the donated parts into keep and fix piles while you label the ones that still need attention.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Leo: Great — I’ll label the donated parts now. Put the labeled ones by the front table, and I’ll keep the repair pile separate.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Faye: Saturday morning around 9 to 11 works for me — just send the exact address when you have it.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll send the exact address as soon as it’s set.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Faye: Sounds good — I can work around school pickup, so just send the address when you have it.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — I’m heading by the repair drive later, so I’ll check what’s still needed and let you know. If I hear anything from the others, I’ll pass it along too.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Leo: Thanks, Ira. Just let me know the next task when you have it.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll swing by and check what’s next, then circle back with you.
events.speaker: Ira
